what: A winding path (SVG line) is bound to scroll and drawn from start to end, from when the section’s top edge reaches 70% of the screen until its bottom edge reaches 70% (no curve, scrub 1.2). For each step along the path, at its own turn (i ÷ (n−1) − .04) the center image pops out, opening from width 0 · 0x to its full width (.14 share, back.out(3.5)). .02 later that step’s note pops from 0x, tilting −5°. Icons and description notes burst out one by one along the path between service names

options.[data-fx-part=path]: Path to draw (if several, drawn together — stack a different path per width and show only one via css)
options.[data-fx-part=grow]: Graphic that spreads out from width 0 within a step (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=note]: Notes that tilt and pop within a step (optional)
options.step: Share by which a single step pops out (out of 1 total), default .14
options.lead: Share that starts ahead of its own turn, default .04
